ImageDescription.value:
Singapore's rapid growth in economical development can be seen along the streets of the central business district. However, Singapore's rich cultural heritage anchors the sense of belonging and identity of singaporeans. In certain ways expressed through religion, where the preservation and safekeeping of religious places of worshipped is practiced and carried out by the singapore authorities. Interweaving threads of heritage and the contemporary building elements of singapore.

In this picture u can see Yueh Hai Ching Temple, a lonely taoist temple stands in between 30 to 50 stories high office buildings. Which reveals the tradition and heritage that singapore deeply values and treasure.

An office worker in office clothing can be seen walking by, right in the middle of the closed doors of the temple, which supports the narrative of a well balanced modern and traditional elements of singapore.
